articleTitle: A Heuristic Algorithm to Solve the Shortest Path Problem with Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a heuristic algorithm to solve the shortest path problem with additional exclusionary or inclusionary restrictions inspired by the practical flight planning problem. The optimal path without considering the additional restrictions is found and a repairing algorithm is applied on it to repair the path to meet the restrictions if necessary and then an iterative heuristic algorithm is applied to optimize the solutions until the preset termination criteria is met. The computational results show that the proposed heuristic algorithm has good performance in both efficiency and quality.

articleTitle: Ambient Power-enabled Internet of Things: 3GPP Standardization Process
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Ambient IoT is an attractive technology due to its low or zero maintenance by using technologies such as Energy Harvesting, Energy Efficient (EE) communication and zero energy IoT technologies. An Ambient power-enabled IoT device refers to an IoT device powered by harvesting energy from ambient environment, being either battery-less or with limited energy storage capability. With its self-power, ultra low-cost and smaller size, maintenance free and long life span (e.g. more than 10 years) characteristics, the Ambient IoT is predicted to be the next generation of IoT. The concept of ambient IoT is originally coined by 3GPP to be a new kind of IoT service for the verticals which need enabling of ambient power-enabled IoT with cellular networks. This paper reports ongoing study on Ambient IoT work by the third generation partnership project service & system aspects work group 1 (3GPP SA WG1) and Radio Access Network work group 1 (3GPP RAN WG1), which aim to study specific use cases and service requirements for 5GS (5G System) in support of ambient IoT devices with lower complexity, smaller size, reduced capabilities and lower power consumption. In this paper, the objectives of the 3GPP SA1 Ambient power-enabled IoT study item (SI) are summarized and some of the most interesting proposed use cases and functions are discussed. Moreover, the new potential requirements including the security requirements for 5GS related to Ambient IoT are also introduced.

articleTitle: Blind Recognition and Detection for Hybrid Modulation in Grant-Free Multiple Access
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Hybrid modulation can improve transmission efficiency, lower bit error rate, and increase the system’s universality and flexibility. However, traditional hybrid modulation recognition methods, such as those based on instantaneous features, are not suitable for autonomous grant-free systems. To address this issue, this paper presents a blind recognition and detection algorithm for hybrid modulation in non-orthogonal multiple access systems with autonomous grant-free. Since low-order modulation constellations have obvious geometric distributions, the number of user signal clusters can be used to identify the modulation scheme. We calculate the ideal threshold based on noise and interference modeling and propose a geometric feature-based method based on the constellation for clustering judgment to realize hybrid modulation recognition and detection. Simulation results are provided, which demonstrate the advantages of the proposed scheme in blind recognition for hybrid modulation under the same conditions.

articleTitle: FCOS-GB-An Improved UAV Aerial Images Detection Method Based on FCOS Model
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Recently, UAVs have been widely used in both military and civilian fields, and UAV systems have increasingly higher requirements for understanding automatic visual data. Aiming at the problems of complex backgrounds, small and dense targets, and large occlusion of UAV aerial images, this paper proposes a new object detection model based on the FCOS model, named: FCOS-GB model. The main improvement measure is to replace ResNeXt as the backbone network of the model, the global context modeling module is introduced and GIoU loss is adopted. In order to verify the model proposed in this paper, experiments are performed on the VisDrone 2019 dataset. The experimental results show that the object detection model based on FCOS has an accuracy index AP of 0.301 for the identification of UAV aerial images. In addition, ablation experiments were performed on the three improvement measures proposed in this paper. The results indicate that the three proposed improvements in this paper have led to certain enhancements in the object detection performance of our model. Therefore, the UAV aerial image detection model based on FCOS model proposed in this paper has certain practical value.

articleTitle: Research on the Frequency Stability of Optoelectronic Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Frequency synthesizer with low phase noise is crucial important. The optoelectronic microwave oscillator (OEO) is an oscillator source with lower phase noise than the normal microwave dielectric oscillator, which uses low loss optical fiber as the energy storage. Because the length of the optical fiber is sensitive to temperature, The signal produced by the OEO has problems with inconsistent and unstable frequency. A method with injection locking and feedback control was proposed in this paper, which can solve the problem of inconsistent frequency and improve the stability of OEO. According to the frequency stability scheme of the optoelectronic oscillator, a prototype is built to verify the correctness of this scheme.

articleTitle: Trusted Log Tracing Framework Based on Fabric
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: System log is an important basis for the system to check the stable running of the system and troubleshoot faults in time. As the software system becomes more and more complex, the log detection becomes more and more difficult. In addition to the increased volume of log data, logs may lack authenticity and have been tampered with before the detection begins. In order to avoid the huge loss caused by system failure not solved in time, we proposed a trusted log tracing framework based on fabric. With this framework, log information is placed on the blockchain as soon as it is generated. On-chain information includes the log generation time, host name, process name and other core contents. Further, we use the deep learning algorithm combined with the chronological characteristics of the log for automatic detection. Blockchain technology ensures the authenticity of data, and deep learning makes detection easier. The framework is mainly composed of two parts, one is information chain, the other is anomaly detection. We implement a log anomaly detection system based on this framework, and our framework is proved to be reliable after experimental testing and evaluation.

articleTitle: WMMSE based Online Optimization Channel Prediction for Massive MIMO in High-mobility
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In 5G massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system, the existing channel prediction methods with online training or optimization can dynamically capture the channel variation by slightly adjusting the parameters of the model or deep neural network (DNN) based on the iteration algorithm. However, it is difficult to capture the rapidly changing channel with slight adjustment based on iteration in high mobility. In this paper, to achieve the accurate online prediction without any iteration, we propose the short-term batch based online optimization channel prediction method based on the autoregressive (AR) model. Inspired by the idea of batches data based training in deep learning (DL), the AR model parameters can be directly optimized using the minimum mean square error (MMSE) criterion in the short-term batch. In addition, considering the different correlations between each channel in the short-term batch and the predicted channel, in order to further improve the online optimization prediction accuracy, the weighted minimum mean square error (WMMSE) based online optimization prediction method is proposed. For the mean square errors calculated from the predicted channels and real channels at different time slots in the short-term batch, the different weights are set to optimize the AR model more accurately. Numerical simulation results show that the proposed architecture can achieve high accurate channel prediction in high mobility scenarios without any iteration.

articleTitle: A Soft De-Mapping Algorithm Combined with Zero Forcing Equalization for M-QAM-OFDM Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Zero forcing equalization is a low complexity method widely used in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) system, and M-ary quadrature amplitude modulation (M-QAM) is the most common subcarrier constellation mapping scheme. This paper presents an M-QAM soft de-mapping algorithm combined with zero forcing equalization for OFDM signal. The algorithms for three different QAM mapping schemes of 4-QAM, 16-QAM and 64-QAM are derived by formula derivation, which are friendly for hardware implementation. To verify the validity of our proposed algorithm, we conduct comparative testing with the classic exact log-likelihood ratio (LLR) approach under the additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channel. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm has almost no system performance loss.

articleTitle: Cramer-Rao Performance Bounds for NLOS Target Localization Behind L-shaped Corner
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Non-line-of-sight (NLOS) targets detection is a crucial concern in both military and civilian applications. Currently, NLOS detection technique is generally focused on utilizing the significant multipath information such as distance, angle, etc., to achieve target localization, which ignores the influence of the multipath number on target localization accuracy. In this paper, the Cramer-Rao Lower Bound (CRLB) for estimation of target position in L-shaped NLOS environment is derived. Specifically, first, the electromagnetic (EM) wave propagation model for the L-shaped scenario via unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV)-borne radar is established to analyse the relationship between the radar altitude and target position. According to the distance relation, the target position is estimated by least squares method. Then, the CRLB is utilized to evaluate the effect of different multipath numbers on target localization accuracy. Finally, several simulations are conducted to indicate that the number of multipath is positively correlated with the accuracy of target localization.

articleTitle: ICI Mitigation Based on CIR Interpolation for Wideband SC-FDE System with High-order Modulation in Dynamic Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Single-carrier frequency domain equalization (SC-FDE) technology is widely used in millimeter wave frequency, and the application of large bandwidth with high spectral efficiency is also being developing rapidly. However, the high rate means more sensitivity to multipath, so we need to increase the guard interval and data block length which introduces large inter-carrier interference (ICI) in high-speed dynamic scenario. The ICI will degrade the performance of higher-order modulation. In this paper, an improved ICI mitigation method is proposed. Under the condition of large normalized carrier frequency offset (NCFO), the channel estimation results are interpolated to reconstruct the time-varying channel impulse response (CIR) matrix, and the frequency domain equalization is performed afterwards. In addition, the SIR analysis and performance simulation are carried out when the normalized carrier frequency offset is up to 20% with 64QAM modulation. The simulation results show that compared with the original linear interpolation approximation, the 2nd and the 3rdorder interpolation approximations have signal-to-interference ratio (SIR) gains of 4dB and 6.5dB respectively. The simulation results illustrate that the bit error rate (BER) is consistent with the SIR. This method is suitable for high-order modulation communication systems with high dynamic and high bandwidth.

articleTitle: GROAMP-Net: An Intelligent Signal Detection Method for Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Signal detection in massive Multiple-Input & Multiple-Output (MIMO) systems usually confronts the challenge of low detection accuracy. Therefore, more effective models and algorithms are still solicited by real-life applications. Artificial intelligence has been widely applied to improving the performances of signal detection. Herein, inspired by the ideas of OAMP-Net model, an intelligent signal detection method, i.e. GROAMP-Net, is put forward. Similar to OAMP-Net, GROAMP-Net also expands the Orthogonal Approximate Message Passing (OAMP) iterations to a deep learning network, in the way that a layer fulfills one iteration. To improve its detection performance, on one hand, GROAMP-Net introduces residual structure to timely correct its signal estimation errors layer by layer; on the other hand, a kind of gate unit is involved to optimize those layer parameters before estimation. Then a corresponding algorithm is designed accordingly based on the GROAMP-Net model. Theoretic analyses show that the computation complexity of GROAMP-Net algorithm keeps the same as that of congeneric algorithms. However, a series of simulation experiments indicate that the comprehensive performances of GROAMP-Net algorithm are better than many benchmarks, including those congeneric ones.

articleTitle: Content-Adaptive Acceleration for Block-based Learned Image Compression
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Learned Image Compression has made great progress recently. However, most existing works process entire images in inference, which may cause out-of-memory errors when with high-resolution images or complex models. To limit peak memory usage, a viable way is to divide an image into blocks and process them separately. We found that blocks with different contents can be represented with varying levels of compactness, e.g., flatter blocks can be more compactly represented to accelerate entropy coding. Thus we propose ClassLIC, which consists of three modules, to achieve content-adaptive acceleration. In detail, Class-Module classifies input blocks into different categories and LIC-Module uses different models to process different categories. An optional Deblock-Module helps mitigate blocking artifacts that may occur in the combined image at low bitrates. Experiments show that ClassLIC reduces coding time to 35.3% of the block-based method at most while maintaining compression efficiency.

articleTitle: Joint Delay and Completion Rate Optimization for Dependent Task Offloading in Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the sixth generation era, communication technologies and network architectures will need to evolve further. The average delay and completion rate of an application are key for quality of experience (QoE). In order to meet the QoE requirement of future users, a software defined space air ground integrated network (SAGIN) framework is first proposed, based on the synergy of ground based stations (BS), unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) and low earth orbiting satellites (LEOS), which can provide mission-relevant computational offloading services for mobile devices (MD). Tasks with dependencies in the application are then modeled by a directed acyclic graph (DAG). And a multi application migration merging model controlled by a software defined network (SDN) controller is developed. Next, a dependent task offloading computational collaboration scheme (DT-OCCS) is developed based on the deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed scheme can well reduce the average delay of the application and increase the completion rate compared to the benchmark schemes.

articleTitle: Network Attack Tracking Method for Digital Substation Power Industry Control System Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The safety of power system is directly related to people’s lives, property and social stability, and even directly affects national security. Because of its importance, power system can easily become the main target of cyber attacks and cyber wars. Constructing the tracing method of power system network attack based on Apriori algorithm is convenient to protect the network assets of substation power industry control system and resist the increasingly hidden network attack. Snort, as a probe for traffic collection and analysis, uses the attack detection of existing and partially customized packets to be detected in official website to extract all kinds of attack information. Snort detection method decomposes the obtained data packets according to the key information of the rules and matches them with all the rules in the rule base respectively. If they meet any rules, it is an attack. The Apriori algorithm is used to mine the detected attacks, and the correlation between them is mined in the data through association rules, and the attacks can be traced back according to the correlation.

articleTitle: A study on the application of digital watermarking techniques on relational databases
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, network and data security technologies have developed rapidly. It brings new challenges to the protection of copyright issues, and integrity issues of relational databases. Digital watermarking is the process of adding information to data through certain algorithms. This information can prove copyright ownership or track infringement. Database watermarking is the application of watermarking technology to relational databases. It is currently the best solution to solve the problem of database ownership and integrity. This paper first introduces the basic concepts and technical models of database watermarks. Then, the research on robust watermarks was analyzed and introduced from three aspects: bit modification, attribute value modification, and constraint modification. The research on fragile watermarks was analyzed and introduced from three aspects: virtual grouping, data features, and specific attributes. Finally, it summarizes the main problems faced by database watermarks in protecting database ownership. It also looks forward to possible future research directions from three aspects: data type limitations, watermark robustness, and applicability.

articleTitle: A 5G-TSN Joint Scheduling Mechanism Considering Finite Buffer in DS-TT
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the advent of Industry 4.0, 5G and Time Sensitive Networking (TSN) are emerging as wireless deterministic communication network to provide solid QoS guarantee for industrial automation services. For 5G-TSN collaboration system, two important gateways are introduced in both network and end device side to support TSN protocols, named as Network-side TSN Translator (NW-TT) and Device-side TSN Translator (DS-TT) respectively. However, 5G and TSN are totally different in terms of resource type, scheduling methodology and management protocols, in order to provide latency guarantee for time-triggered flows across 5G and TSN, as well as to make two different scheduling of 5G and TSN coordinately, a 5G-TSN joint scheduling mechanism based on enhanced Maximum Latency Weighted Delay First (eMLWDF) is proposed and analyzed in this paper. The proposed mechanism designs an adaptive factor in scheduling procedure to make well balance between achieving low latency in 5G and avoiding buffer overflow in DS-TT. Furthermore, some packet will arrival at the priority queue in DS-TT later than the period of "ON" for that queue due to fluctuations of radio channel, to avoid this situation, a frame preemption scheme is adopted to provide latency guarantee. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed mechanism can satisfy the latency requirements of time-triggered flows as well as reduce data buffer volumes in DS-TT, aiming to provide deterministic communication guarantee for data transmission across 5G and TSN.

articleTitle: Using Deep Reinforcement Learning for 5G RAN Slicing Resource Allocation in New Power Load Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, extreme weather has caused unstable power generation on the power side, posing a great need to build a new power load management system to unleash the ability of flexible load regulation for ensuring the balance between power grid sources and loads. The new power load management system needs to monitor and regulate dispersed load resources, thus posing higher requirements for the real-time performance and resource guarantee capabilities of communication networks. Currently, there is no slicing algorithm and communication resource allocation algorithm specifically designed for the new power load management system in 5G communication networks. To address these issues, this paper categorizes the service of the new power load management system and uses 5G slicing to carry it out, establishing a new power load management system 5G radio access net-work(RAN) slicing resource allocation model. The slicing resource allocation problem is transformed into a Markov decision process, and the state space, action space, and reward function are designed. Additionally, a dueling deep Q network(DQN) based 5G RAN slicing resource allocation algorithm is proposed, which learns from the historical resource needs of slices to provide the optimal resource allocation strategy. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can meet the communication resource needs of the new power load management system and has very high resource utilization efficiency.

articleTitle: Vehicle Point Cloud Segmentation Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A vehicle point cloud segmentation model is designed to address the common issue of real-time acquisition of point cloud of vehicle body and wheels in intelligent parking systems. Firstly, a Multi resolution Feature Pruning Segmentation Network (MFPS-Net) is proposed. This method takes pure point cloud information as input, adopts PointNet++ trunk network, and integrates channel level pruning to accurately segment vehicle point clouds while improving model segmentation efficiency. Then, in order to verify the effectiveness of the model, a dataset with real labels was generated from the vehicle point cloud using bilateral LiDAR data collected from the vehicle buffer. Finally, point cloud segmentation experiments were conducted. The experimental results showed that the accuracy of vehicle point cloud segmentation reached 92.01%.

articleTitle: OptimizeLog: Log Anomaly Detection and Localization based on Optimized Log Parsing in Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Modern distributed systems generate interleaved logs when performing parallel operations, and these logs become an important basis for anomaly detection and localization. To achieve more robust and accurate log anomaly detection and localization, we propose a comprehensive model, namely OptimizeLog. We built a dictionary- and length-based log parser that works stably in most log systems without parameter tuning. We significantly improve anomaly detection accuracy by introducing ALBERT-based semantic embeddings, count embeddings, and time embeddings, combined with an attentionbased Bi-GRU model. By constructing component instance forest and tree-based depth-first traversal algorithm, abnormal location in distributed systems is realized. Experimental results show that our log parsing method is 4% more accurate than other log parsers. Compared with other advanced methods such as DeepLog, LogAnomaly, and LogRobust, OptimizeLog improves the accuracy of anomaly detection by 5%, while enabling instancelevel anomaly localization on real datasets.

articleTitle: Oriented Object Detection in Aerial Images with Double Midpoint Vectors
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, oriented object detection technology has made significant progress. Most oriented object detectors represent oriented bounding boxes by adding additional angle information to the horizontal bounding box representation, which leads to serious angle periodicity issues. To address these issues, this paper proposes double midpoint vectors (DMvectors) to represent oriented objects. For any oriented bounding box, we align the center point with the origin in the Cartesian coordinate system, and evenly distribute the midpoints of the box edges across the four quadrants. We use the midpoint of the first and second quadrants, as well as the width and height of the box, to represent the oriented bounding box. DMvectors solve the periodic problem of angles by implicitly including angle information in vectors. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method, we conducted extensive experiments on two common remote sensing datasets (DOTA and HRSC2016), and our method achieved competitive results.

articleTitle: Spectrally-Null-Constrained Sequence Pair Sets
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we employ the Kronecker product to establish a collection of spectrally-null-constrained sequence pairs (SNCSPs) characterized by zero correlation zone autocorrelation and low constant cross-correlation properties. Initially, we introduce a category of equal-autocorrelation sequence pairs (EACSPs) featuring arbitrary SNC positions. Subsequently, we prove that the characteristic sequence pairs arising from the two categories of difference set pairs are indeed EACSPs with SNC characteristics. Next, we apply the Kronecker product to combine the EASCP and the Zadoff-Chu sequence set, resulting in the creation of an SNCSP set characterized by periodic spectral null constraints. In the context of a non-contiguous carrier communication system, the utilization of SNCSPs leads to the independence of transmitted and received sequences. Consequently, the flexibility of SNCSP design is enhanced, the design outcomes become more resilient, and the findings presented in this paper extend available signal choices for non-contiguous carrier communication systems.

articleTitle: Relay Node Deployment in Roadside Traffic Detection System Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In a wireless sensor network system for roadside traffic detection, the deployment of relay nodes is a key issue. This work proposes an enhanced genetic algorithm to solve the relay node placement problem, ensuring full sensor node coverage while minimizing the number of relay nodes and optimizing coverage redundancy. The proposed algorithm incorporates various strategies to improve convergence speed during population initialization, combining heuristics and randomization. A novel repair operation efficiently transforms infeasible solutions into feasible ones, guiding the algorithm in a thorough exploration of the solution space. One of the algorithm’s standout features is an adaptive multi-bit mutation strategy that enhances its ability to escape local optima during optimization. The experimental results show that the performance of our algorithm is superior to algorithms such as NSGA-II, Greedy Integrated GA, Classic GA, and Harizan’s GA.

articleTitle: A Simple Fusion of Self-Attention and BERT for Aspect-Level Sentiment Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aspect-level sentiment classification is aimed to identify the sentiment polarity of a user with respect to certain aspects (features) of a product, and fine-grained sentiment judgements can provide more accurate recommendation results for a wide range of users. Existing deep learning methods have achieved good performance on aspect-level sentiment classification tasks. However, some approaches ignore the modelling of comment semantics or key aspect terms, resulting in ineffective integration of the overall semantics of user comments and the specific sentiment attributes of aspect terms. In this paper, we propose a novel aspect-level sentiment classification approach which uses the pre-trained model to learn high-level semantic features of the input text, employing the self-attention mechanism to capture aspect word feature representations of text sequences. Meanwhile, we introduce dynamic sentiment weight in the model architecture to guide the model to effectively fuse the high-level features of the input sequences and aspect words during the training process, thus obtaining the final feature representations of the input sequences. Experimental results on 2 datasets demonstrate that our proposed method significantly outperforms other baseline methods, proving its effectiveness and superiority.

articleTitle: A Review of Network Resource Scheduling in Distance Education Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, resource scheduling in distance education scenarios faces new opportunities and challenges. In the context of large-scale distance education, how to realize rational scheduling of network resources is an issue worthy of systematic research. From the perspective of distance education, this paper provides an overview of the multiple factors that need to be considered in the current scheduling of distance education network resources, as well as the development of related optimization algorithms and network technologies. At the same time, the future development direction and trend are proposed for the problems and challenges faced by distance education network resource scheduling. In order to improve the utilization of network resources and the learning effect of students, the rational scheduling of network resources in distance education scenarios still needs continuous exploration and research.

articleTitle: Missing Data Imputation Model Based on Improved DAE for LEO Satellite Network
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Time series consisting of terrestrial multi-user access traffic to the low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite is essential for analysing satellite load variations. However, missing values is ubiquitous in complex satellite networks due to collector failures, transmission errors, and memory failures. Incomplete time series prevents effective utilisation of data and reduces the performance of data-driven models. To overcome this problem, in this paper, we propose a novel missing data imputation (IDAE-MDI) model based on improved denoising autoencoder (DAE). Specifically, we combine DAE with gramian angular summation field (GASF) to convert the input time series of DAE into 2-dimensional image representation to establish the temporal correlation between different time intervals and extract the structural patterns from the time series. Then, the missing values initialisation method of DAE is improved by taking advantage of the unique spatial correlation of LEO satellite network traffic. Experiments on real traffic datasets show that the improvements to the DAE have significant effects, while the IDAE-MDI model has lower missing values imputation errors than the baseline model for different missing data rates.

articleTitle: Low-complexity Implementation Method for GLRT Detector for Rank-one Signal in Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The generalized likelihood ratio test (GLRT) detector has excellent performance in detecting rank-one signal. However, the high computational complexity hinders its further application. To this end, a low-complexity implementation method based on the numerical analysis theory for the detector is proposed. Our method uses the accelerated power method based on Rayleigh quotient to iteratively compute the maximum eigenvalue, which has a faster convergence rate in detecting high-dimensional signals compared with the traditional power method; meanwhile, a direct threshold calculation method based on the cubic spline interpolation theory is proposed, which can quickly determine the threshold corresponding to any given target false-alarm probability. Our method effectively improves the computational efficiency and reduces the implementation complexity of the GLRT detector for rank-one signal. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Realtime-Superlets Algorithm for Realtime Super-Resolution Heart Rate Estimation Using FMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents a realtime-superlets (RT-SL) algorithm for monitoring heart rate (HR) in FMCW radar systems. The algorithm achieves realtime monitoring and super-resolution for accurate HR estimation. In the context of HR monitoring using FMCW radar, time-frequency analysis methods are essential for analysing time-varying HR signals. Conventional time-frequency analysis methods often yield ambiguous time-frequency representations. In comparison, the SL algorithm can generate super-resolution time-frequency maps compared to conventional methods. One limitation of the SL algorithm lies in the inability to process data in realtime. To address this limitation, we propose the RT-SL algorithm in this paper. The RT-SL algorithm can process data in realtime by right-aligning the data. We verify the effectiveness of the RT-SL algorithm using a 24 GHz FMCW radar. The experimental results show that the proposed RT-SL algorithm provides superior super-resolution in the HR time-frequency map. It outperforms traditional time-frequency analysis methods in HR estimation.

articleTitle: NDN over TCP with Multi-Level Congestion Control
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order for the named-data networking (NDN) to be adopted in a real world, its deployment in the Internet-scale IP network is indispensable. This paper proposes an NDN over TCP approach where the NDN nodes exchange NDN packets via a TCP connection established between them. Specifically, this paper focus on the multi-level congestion control executed in TCP and NDN levels. This paper also shows the results of performance evaluation for the proposed approach in comparison with NDN over TCP with simple TCP congestion control and NDN over UDP with rate-based congestion control.

articleTitle: Skeleton-based Action Recognition with Multi-stream, Temporal-Channel Enhanced Graph Convolution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Graph Convolution Network (GCN) is a commonly used method in skeleton action recognition, but how to extract complex spatio-temporal features more effectively to improve the recognition accuracy is still a problem to be solved. In this paper, we propose (1) Difference temporal graph convolution (DT-GCN) and (2) Multi-scale interactional channel excitation (MS-ICE) attention layer. The DT-GCN utilizes temporal difference compute the adjacency matrix for each frame increasing the flexibility of spatial modeling. The MS-ICE module use multi-scale convolution kernels to capture sensitive relationships between spatio-temporal and channel dimensions. In addition, since angle information can be a great response to motion variations between joints, we use angles together with conventional articulated skeletons to form a multi-stream fusion framework. By combining the above, we designed a multi-stream, temporal-channel enhanced graph convolution network (MS-TCEGCN), and extensive experiments on the NTU-RGB+D dataset show that our model performs at state-of-the-art level.

articleTitle: Improved Object Detection Algorithm for Workshop Environments Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the context of workshop-restricted environments, this paper presents an improved lightweight detection algorithm named YOLO-M3C to achieve safety helmet wearing detection on embedded devices in real-time while handling multiple video streams efficiently. YOLO-M3C introduces two key enhancements. Firstly, it replaces the backbone network of YOLOv5 with the more lightweight MobileNetV3 network for feature extraction. This improvement significantly reduces the network's parameter count, resulting in enhanced computational speed and a substantial decrease in computational resource requirements. Secondly, the attention mechanism CBAM is introduced to increase the model's focus on important features, leading to further improvements in detection accuracy. CBAM helps the model better comprehend crucial information in the images, thereby enhancing detection algorithm performance. Experimental results demonstrate that YOLO-M3C achieves increased average precision while shortening the training time by 15%. Additionally, the improved algorithm reduces the parameter count of the YOLOv5 model by 52%, effectively reducing model size and training time, while enhancing detection efficiency. The improved YOLOv5 algorithm can be effectively deployed on embedded devices in workshop environments, enabling efficient real-time processing of multiple video streams and reliable safety helmet wearing detection, thus meeting the real-time detection requirements in workshop settings.

articleTitle: Considerations on Potential Air-Interface Impact and Deployment Strategies of Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) is one of the most promising techniques for 6G communication. Till now, a lot of field tests on RIS prototypes have been done, which shows the potential capability of RIS for future wireless network. In order to promote the development of RIS, we provide a comprehensive analysis on the potential air-interface impact considering practical deployment of RIS from the standardization evolution perspective. Furthermore, we analyze the potential deployment strategies for RIS from different aspects, taking into account the standardization progress, size of RIS and height of RIS deployment. In the end, considerations on engineering issues for RIS are provided from operator’s point of views.

articleTitle: Learning-based Task-Offloading for Mobile Edge Computing with User Mobility
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Mobile edge computing (MEC), envisioned as a cloud computing extension, is becoming an essential architecture for data transmission. The system performance (such as the execution delay) can be improved by offloading tasks from mobile user (MU) to edge servers. However, there is a lack of research on task offloading in the case of random movement of MUs. In this paper, we study the task offloading problem considering the MUs’ mobility. We model the task offloading problem as a Multi-armed Bandit (MAB) model. We then study the task offloading algorithms based on the typical Upper-Confidencial-Bound (UCB) and ε-greedy algorithms, which can make efficient task offloading decisions by adaptively learning the MU’s mobile property. By investigating the impact of the mobile property on network performance, we further propose an EPE-UCB task offloading algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate the efficiency of our algorithm in achieving low cost.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Determination Method for Gop-size and Qp Offset in Versatile Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the latest and most advanced video coding standard, Versatile Video Coding (VVC), the configuration parameters of the size of Groups of Pictures (GOP) and the offset of Quantization Parameter (QP) in a GOP significantly impact the compression efficiency. However, typical VVC encoder implementations assume fixed GOP-size and QP offset for encoding video sequences, which is inefficient for video sequences with diverse content and cannot guarantee optimal rate-distortion performance for diverse video sequences. In this paper, we propose a simple but effective adaptive determination method for GOP-size and QP offset in VVC. Specifically, the GOPsize and the QP offset are adaptively determined according to the temporal characteristics of video sequences, and such temporal characteristics are calculated based on existing motion vectors in the encoded information. Experimental results have demonstrated that, with a negligible increase in encoding time, the proposed method can reduce Bjøntegaard delta bit-rate (BDBR) by 5.53% on average compared with the original VVC.

articleTitle: Achieving Covert Communication in Underlay Cognitive Radio Networks Using a Multi-Antenna Receiver
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Covert communication can hide the information transmission process and prevent the communication behavior from being detected by eavesdroppers. In this paper, we propose a multi-antenna underlay cognitive radio networks (UCRN) covert communication scheme, which selects the best antenna of the secondary receiver (SR) to receive covert information from the secondary transmitter (ST), and then selects an antenna from the remaining antennas to generate interference noise with different power. The uncertainty of interference power is used to realize the covert communication of multi-antenna receiver. We derive the minimum detection error rate, and transmission outage probability of Willie, and evaluate the covert performance of the scheme. The numerical results show that the maximum interference tolerance of the primary receiver (PR) and the maximum interference power of multiple antennas in SR can make ST realize covert transmission.

articleTitle: A method based on CNN-BiLSTM for UAV navigation error compensation in GNSS denied environment
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: When the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signal is unavailable, the performance of GNSS/Inertial Navigation System (INS) integrated navigation system will be seriously degraded. In order to compensate the performance of GNSS/INS integrated navigation system, an error compensation method based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) combined with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network is proposed. In the proposed method, the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) dynamics measurement of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) is used as the input, the GNSS high-precision navigation information is used as the label. CNN-BiLSTM establishes the relationship between IMU dynamics measurement and GNSS high-precision navigation information through the training of a large number of input and label data, since it can achieve more accurate prediction of position increment and velocity increment. At last, the experimental results show that when the GNSS signal is unavailable, CNN-BiLSTM obtains the lower average RMSE and MAE of prediction error and the higher prediction fitting degree compared with CNN-LSTM and LSTM.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv3 Method for Detecting Surface Defects in Cold Rolled Steel Strip
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Surface defects of cold rolled strip steel is an important influence on the quality of strip steel products, however, cold rolled strip steel is more prone to various surface defects due to the long production process, thin specifications and other factors, so the detection of these defects is the key to the production of high-quality products. So far, although many researches have proposed relevant algorithms, they cannot well meet the requirements of speed and accuracy, therefore, we have improved on the basis of YOLOv3, so that it can achieve the optimal effect in the detection of surface defects of cold rolled strip steel. Briefly, we introduced SENet in the feature map extraction stage to improve the feature extraction ability of the model, automatically learn the relevance and importance of the features of each layer in the channel dimension, and realize the adaptive fusion between different features; and replace the K-Means clustering algorithm with K-Means++ clustering algorithm. The experimental results show that the improved model proposed in this study has better performance.

articleTitle: Robust Synchronization Method for Burst OFDM Systems based on AGC Compensation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel low latency burst short frame orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) synchronization approach utilizing automatic gain control (AGC) gain compensation. By eradicating the guard sequence to expedite the process and leveraging AGC feedback gain values to correct distorted training sequence, our method simultaneously diminishes the time cost and enhances the synchronization performance. Simulation results show that in comparison to non-compensated methods, the proposed synchronization approach can amplify the signal-to-noise ratio by about 1 dB for the same normalized mean square error. Moreover, the frequency synchronization performance closely mirrors those sequences with a higher point count. Given the same frequency synchronization performance, the sequence length required by the proposed method is only 64% of the non-compensated methods, resulting in an estimated time resource savings during synchronization.

articleTitle: Comments on "A Lightweight Privacy Preserving Authentication Protocol for VANETs"
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Vehicle use and the concept of a "smart city" are developing quickly. As a result of this progression, the Vehicular Ad-Hoc Network (VANET) is a popular network for inter-vehicular communication. The data gathering about the state of the road, the whereabouts of vehicles, their speeds, and the description of traffic congestion are obtained using the VANET. The public nature of information flow on the VANET creates serious security risks. Data security is typically one of the most important duties of VANET. As a result, it becomes one of the researchers’ top priorities. Li et al. [1] introduced a Lightweight Privacy Preserving Authentication Protocol for VANETs. They stated that several attacks could be resisted using their secure authentication devised protocol. However, after analyzing we discovered that their authentication protocol is susceptible to roadside impersonation attack and it does not provide vehicle anonymity. In the end, we have provided a few suggestions to cope with Li et al.’s devised protocol current shortcomings.

articleTitle: XOR-Based (k,n) Visual Cryptography Scheme With Meaningful Shares
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Visual cryptography scheme (VCS) is a kind of secret sharing, when distributing noise-like shares to participants, it is easy to attract the attention of attackers. In this paper, two novel XOR-based progressive (k,n) visual cryptography schemes ((k,n)-XVCS) with meaningful shares have been proposed, visual qualities of recovered images appear multi-level upgrade when the number of the stacked shares increases. Extensive experimental results are demonstrated, exhibiting the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed method.

articleTitle: SFT-based Channel Estimation for OFDM Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Channel estimation plays an important role in OFDM, which is favored for broadband systems. Conventional channel estimation methods transform domain by DFT to suppress the time domain noise of the LS estimates. Sparse Fourier Transform (SFT) has been proposed as a solution to shorten the computational complexity of the Fourier transform of sparse signal. In this paper, we propose an enhanced algorithm to make a better trade-off between performance and complexity. The dominant entries of channel impulse response are obtained directly by sparse inverse Fourier transform. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm yields a satisfactory estimation performance at a lower computational complexity.

articleTitle: Fusion Cross-Attention Convolutional Recurrent Network for Residual Echoes and Noise Suppression in Acoustic Echo Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of smart devices, voice interaction has become more frequent, and echoes and background noise are unavoidable during hands-free calls. Many previously proposed deep learning methods as a post-filtering module simply concatenate on error signals and estimated echoes as input features without considering the information interaction between them. In this paper, we propose the Cross Attention (CA) module to interactively fuse the feature information between the inputs and apply it to the Convolutional Recurrent Network structure (CRN). In addition, the fusion skip connection (FSC) module is also proposed to enable the decoder to simultaneously sense the fused information of the error signal and the estimated echo, which is benefit to improve the echo cancellation effect. Ablation experiments of the FCACRN model proposed in this paper on the synthetic test set show the effectiveness of the proposed module, which can eliminate echoes and noise more effectively. Meanwhile, the blind test set in the AEC Challenge also obtained excellent scores. The AECMOS of this method is 4.41 points, 0.54 points higher than the baseline, which proves the excellent performance of the proposed model.

articleTitle: An Angular Sweeping-Based Beam Training Scheme for Extremely Large Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the extremely large antenna array (ELAA) system, the region of near-field can’t be neglected. The far-field beam training scheme searching the optimal angle is unsuitable for the near-field. To address this problem, we begin by defining the angular support interval to represent the angular region where the signal gain is exhibited during angle beam sweeping. Subsequently, a beam training scheme with two-stage angle beam sweeping is introduced, where wide-angle beam sweeping and narrow-angle beam sweeping are performed sequentially. After the angle beam sweeping, the angular support interval can be obtained and the optimal beamforming vector is estimated. Simulation results verify the superior performance and low overhead of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Binaural Audio Synthesis with the Structured State Space sequence model
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The structured state-space sequence model (S4) is a recent innovation in sequence modeling that has shown excellent performance in handling long-range dependencies across a variety of tasks and modalities. In the field of speech processing, it has been found to be an alternative to the self-attention model in automatic speech recognition and in speech synthesis. In this study, a new model for synthesizing binaural speech is developed that represents the long relationship between mono speech using S4 and the latent state space between speaker and source location information. Each layer is conditioned with information common to both left and right sides of the speech, which is processed by location, binaural time difference, and pre-trained binaural speech. Compared to conventional methods, our model shows that speech synthesis is possible with similar quality. These results indicate that our model has the potential to extend the applicability of S4 in sequence modeling and into the domain of conditional speech synthesis.

Author Keywords: binaural audio sound spatialization binaural speech speech processing speech generation

articleTitle: Joint Phase Shift and Deployment Optimization for Multi-RIS-aided Emergency Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In post-disaster scenario, the irregular and scattered distribution of obstacles usually poses challenges to emergency communications. As a promising technology, reconfigurable intelligence surfaces (RISs) can reduce the impact of obstacles and expand the coverage of the base station (BS) by optimizing their phase-shift and deployment. However, the existing work has only applied RISs to barrier-free or simple-barrier scenarios. In this paper, multi-RIS-aided emergency communications are studied under the complex-barrier scenario after disasters, where strong coupling between RISs is introduced. Specifically, we jointly optimize the phase-shift and deployment of multiple RISs to maximize the weight sum-rate (WSR) with ensuring communications fairness for post-disaster users. An alternating iterative algorithm for this multi-RIS-aided complex-barrier scenario (AI-MRCB) is proposed, which is based on the successive convex approximation (SCA) and the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). Simulation results show that the proposed AI-MRCB method can deploy RISs appropriately and improve users’ WSR than the existing work.

articleTitle: Temporal Transformation Network Based On Scale Sequences for Cloth-Changing Person Re-Identification in Video Datasets
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper introduces the Temporal Transform Network based on Scale Sequences (TTS) for cloth-changing person re-identification in video datasets. The TTS network is designed to capture multi-scale temporal cues within video sequences. It accomplishes this by initially modeling short-term temporal cues between adjacent frames, followed by capturing long-term relationships between non-consecutive frames. In more detail, short-term temporal cues are modeled through parallel inflated convolutions with different time dilation rates, enabling the representation of pedestrian movement and appearance dynamics. Long-term relationships are effectively captured using a temporal self-attention model, mitigating challenges such as occlusion and noise within the video sequence. The TTS network outperforms existing methods across cloth-changing video ReID datasets such as CCVID. For instance, under general settings, our approach exhibits a 1.1% improvement in top-1 accuracy and a corresponding 1.1% increase in mAP compared to the baseline. In cloth-changing settings, we observe a 0.2% enhancement in top-1 accuracy and a notable 1.3% increase in mAP relative to the baseline.

Author Keywords: cloth-changing person re-identification in video datasets

articleTitle: Improved K-means Algorithm for Fault Diagnosis of Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper aims to improve the accuracy of anomaly data identification in fault diagnosis of vehicle using an improved K-means clustering algorithm. To address the sensitivity of initial cluster centroids and the tendency to fall into local optima when identifying anomaly data with traditional K-means clustering algorithms, we propose an IDBO-Kmeans clustering algorithm for vehicle fault diagnosis. The algorithm is based on the original Dung Beetle Optimization algorithm and introduces three optimization strategies: chaotic mapping, adaptive boundary adjustment, and random walk, to improve the quality of initial cluster centroids. The optimized initial cluster centroid are then used with the K-means algorithm for further clustering. Experimental results show that IDBO-Kmeans improves the accuracy of anomaly data identification in vehicle fault diagnosis and addresses the limitations of traditional K-means clustering.

articleTitle: Research on object detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low detection speed, high leakage rate, and reduced detection speed after migrating to embedded devices in the workshop object detection task, an improved object detection algorithm for YOLOv7 is proposed. In the improved algorithm, a lightweight ShuffleNetv2 network is introduced to improve the YOLOv7 algorithm based on the YOLOv7 network framework. Since the ReLU function is used in the ShuffleNetv2 network, and the ReLU function will cause neuron "necrosis" during the training process, the SiLU activation function in the YOLOv7 network structure is used to replace the ReLU function in ShuffleNetv2, which meets the accuracy rate and at the same time has a better performance. Therefore, the SiLU activation function in the YOLOv7 network structure is used to replace the ReLU function in ShuffleNetv2, which can satisfy the accuracy and at the same time have better detection speed. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the improved algorithm on the test set Precision (P) reaches 91.7%, Recall (R) reaches 81.4%, and mean Average Precision (mAP) increases by 2.9 percentage points. The improved algorithm can effectively guarantee the detection speed in the real scene detection task, and at the same time reduce the leakage rate to a great extent, showing good detection performance.

articleTitle: Communication Anti-jamming Method Based on POMDP Model under Limited State Information Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In circumstances where hardware constraints restrict the communication system's ability to gather comprehensive channel state information, this paper introduces an anti-jamming method for communication, founded on the Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) model. This method follows a sequential process: first, it acquires observation results from selected channels during the current time slot and the belief state pertaining to the target frequency band from the previous time slot. Subsequently, it updates the belief state for the current time slot. Finally, using heuristic algorithms based on value functions to make decisions based on the belief state of the current time slot. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method consistently attains a high level of accuracy in communication decision-making when countering tracking jamming, linear sweep jamming, and combined tracking and linear sweep jamming. Remarkably, these outcomes are achieved exclusively with the limited communication channel state information obtained.

articleTitle: An encrypted traffic classification neural network optimized by heuristic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As countries around the world have higher and higher requirements for information security, and the traffic transmitted in the network is required to be encrypted to different degrees, so the proportion of encrypted traffic in the network is becoming higher and higher, attack traffic in the network is also becoming encrypted, making it difficult to obtain the type of attack traffic and making defense difficult. However, due to regulatory requirements, network managers want to understand the distribution of different types of traffic or attack traffic in the network without decryption, so the classification of encrypted traffic has become a difficult problem. Aiming at tackling this challenge, this study provides a method based on heuristic algorithm to do feature optimization, paired with deep learning for classification, and the accuracy of classification is used as the optimization equation of heuristic algorithm. This experiment leverages the ISCX-VPN2016 public dataset for experimental study. the final experimental accuracy has reach to 94.17%, the model displays good optimization effect, and the model can be transplanted to other tasks, with great robustness.

articleTitle: Joint Source-Channel Polarization Successive Cancellation Decoding
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The Double-Polar (D-Polar) code is an innovative scheme that combines source coding and channel coding into a joint coding framework. It aimed at improving the reliability and efficiency of information transmission. By integrating source coding and channel coding, the D-Polar code aims to minimize the bit error rate, enhance the signal’s resilience to interference, and improve its fault tolerance. In this paper, a new type of joint source-channel decoder called Joint Successive Cancellation (J-SC) Decoder is proposed. The proposed approach aims to enhance the decoding performance of D-Polar codes. The merging of nodes representing the information bits of the channel and the nodes corresponding to the high-entropy bits of the source is achieved through the creation of joint source-channel (J) nodes. Based on this joint coding approach, the J-SC decoder is designed to recover the source message by combining source SC decoding with channel SC decoding. During J-SC decoding, the bit values are recovered symbol by symbol. For each J node, the values of source log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) and channel log-likelihood ratios (LLRc) are considered. The simulation results indicate that the decoding performance of J-SC surpasses that of SC decoding, and the performance improves as the overall code rate decreases.

articleTitle: A PUF-based IoT Authentication Model in Edge Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Edge computing proposes to solve the problems such as high bandwidth load and long delays when a great number of terminal devices connect to the IoT. However, the addition of the edge layer also poses new challenges to authentication security between devices at all levels of the IoT. The characteristics and communication requirements of cloud, edge, and terminal devices in the edge computing environment has been analyzed, and four types of authentication schemes is designed, which provides a basis for further research on the authentication problem of IoT devices in edge computing environment.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Multi-modal Attention for Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Because of the rapid development of intelligent monitoring, Person Re-Identification has become one of the most popular research areas. Especially in recent years, with the widespread deployment of RGB-IR Dual mode Cameras, infrared images can assist in Person Re-Identification. These advancements effectively solve the problem that visible cameras cannot effectively capture person images under complex lighting condition, such as at night or low-light environments. Most existing methods focus on extracting modality-shared features and modality-level alignment. In this paper, we propose a Fusion Multi-modal Transformer(FMT) for Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification. Concretely, Our method uses a Transformer-based feature extractor to generate discriminative features from two modalities. Moreover, the bidirectional multi-modal attention block is introduced to obtain modality-specific information and fuse complementary semantic information for identification. Our experiments have shown that the model has outstanding performance with achieving 99.86% prediction accuracy on SYSUMM01, and achieving 94.13% accuracy on LLCM.

articleTitle: New Impulsive SMC for Master-Slave Neural Networks with Stochastic and Unknown Input Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents impulsive sliding mode control (SMC) technique to examine the exponential synchronization of master-slave neural networks with unknown input disturbances and stochastic disturbance. An innovative sliding function of integral type with impulsive sequences is introduced. Then, by considering Lyapunov function, Halanay inequality of stochastic differential equations, and LMIs technique, we create novel sufficient conditions to investigate synchronization problem between two different chaotic delayed neural networks (DNNs). Next, a new SMC law based on disturbance observer (DO) is created and the DO designed by us can overcome many limitations regarding unknown input disturbances. Lastly, a simulated example verifies the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Brain Visual Stimulus Reconstruction Using a Three-Stage Multilevel Deep Fusion Model
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Currently, the field of brain visual stimulus decoding from functionally synthesized MRI images has gained increaseing attention from researchers. However, challenges such as the scarcity of fMRI data samples and the low signal-to-noise ratio of fMRI data have resulted in issues related to pixel-level reconstructed images. These problems include low clarity, structural confusion, and unclear semantics. To address these challenges, this paper employs a three-stage multiscale deep fusion model (TMDFM). The model follows a three-stage training process that extracts low-level feature maps from depth images, high-level feature information from original images, and then combines them to obtain improved feature representations. Additionally, this paper incorporates a random shifting module, a dual attention module, and a multiscale feature fusion module to enhance image generation. In the context of the Horikawa17 dataset, quantitative comparisons using paired SSIM and human perceptual similarity achieved average scores of 76.0% and 92.0%, respectively, outperforming other methods. Moreover, this model demonstrates strong generalization capabilities by delivering impressive results on a handwritten dataset. Finally, this paper explores the contributions of different brain regions to decoding results and conducts several ablation experiments.

articleTitle: A Multi-parameter Compensated Min-Sum Based LDPC Decoding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The Minimum Sum (MS) algorithm is a standard Low-Density Parity-Check Codes (LDPC) decoding algorithm. Compared with traditional algorithms, it uses approximate calculations to reduce the computational complexity of the algorithm when calculating parity nodes, resulting in performance loss issues. To improve the LDPC decoding performance, the LDPC decoding algorithm of Multi-parameter Compensated Min-Sum (MCMS) is proposed. This algorithm introduces relevant information, such as channel and code length, into calculating update verification nodes. Introducing multiplication and correction factors to reduce errors in validation node calculations through multi-parameter compensation. Simulation results show that the MCMS algorithm has superior error rate performance compared with the MS algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Urban Water Supply Network Leakage Forecasting Based on the LSTM-AM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The effective forecasting of urban water supply network leakage is the premise and basis for network leakage control. In response to the problem that Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network tends to ignore the importance of data information, an urban water supply network leakage forecasting model is proposed based on the combination of LSTM and Attention Mechanism (AM). In this paper, the original leakage data of the District Metering Area in Zhuzhou City are used as the research object and pre-processed by Savitzky-Golay filter smoothing. Then, the LSTM network is used to extract the trajectory features of the leakage data. Finally, the AM network is introduced to extract the key feature information and automatically fit the weights to strengthen the ability of the model to obtain the key feature information of the leakage data. The experimental results show that the proposed LSTM-AM model could better capture correlations and has higher accuracy in pipe network leakage forecasting than the typical LSTM model and CNN-LSTM model.

Author Keywords: urban water supply network leakage forecasting

articleTitle: WRR dynamic resource allocation algorithm in visible light communication and WiFi heterogeneous network
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes a weighted round-robin (WRR) algorithm based on the round-robin (RR) algorithm and proportional fairness (PF) algorithm aimed to enhance the quality of service (QoS) in visible light communication (VLC)/WiFi heterogeneous networks. Before each scheduling round, the algorithm assigns the user’s priority based on the user’s instantaneous request rate, distance to the nearest access point, and shadow fading. Meanwhile, user resource prioritization in different areas is proposed, considering the differences in VLC and WiFi coverage. Simulation results demonstrate that the WRR algorithm improves the system’s throughput while maintaining fairness and can provide users with an improved communication experience, thereby increasing its application potential.

articleTitle: A new framework for cigarette market state prediction based on LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Cigarette market state prediction is of great importance in the tobacco industry. Accurate cigarette market state prediction can help enterprises make decision support, production optimization, supply chain management, and improve sales efficiency and market competitiveness. Traditional prediction methods are not effective in dealing with large-scale data and complex correlations, and the evaluation of the market state lacks representativeness and scientificity.In this paper, an integrated prediction framework is proposed to predict the cigarette market state. This prediction framework is based on a brand-new market state composite index and LightGBM prediction model. The new market state composite index considers the state from different dimensions of market changes. Then LightGBM is used as our prediction tool to predict the index. To evaluate the prediction effectiveness of the models, we compare the prediction results of various state-of-the-art machine learning models. The experimental results show that the new framework based on LightGBM can effectively predict the cigarette market state and obtain better prediction accuracy. This new framework provides a reference for the prediction and analysis of cigarette marketing analytics.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Object Detection Method for Photovoltaic Panel UAV Inspection Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Photovoltaic panels are the core equipment of photovoltaic power plants and require regular inspections. To improve inspection efficiency, unmanned aerial vehicles are currently mainly used to take infrared photos of photovoltaic panels for inspection. Therefore, how to quickly and accurately detect fault objects from infrared photos of photovoltaic panels has become a hot research topic. The two-stage detection method generally has drawbacks such as slow detection speed and difficulty in detecting video data. This paper adopts the one-stage object detection method YOLOv5 for detection, and preprocesses the original image data according to the characteristics of the problem, improving the model. Firstly, to address the issues of low resolution of infrared images of photovoltaic panels and unclear boundaries between fault and normal areas, grayscale transformation was performed on the original image to improve the contrast of the image area; Secondly, to address the issue of relatively low proportion of fault object data in the entire image, Mosaic-9 was used to expand and enhance the original image data; Finally, the performance of the model was improved by introducing the Squeeze and Exception (SE) attention mechanism module into the model. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can detect faulty objects in real-time in the infrared images of photovoltaic panels captured by drones during inspection. Compared with the original YOLOv5 method, the improved YOLOv5 method has improved Precision, Recall, mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95 by about 20 percentage points.

articleTitle: Rain Rate and Water Vapor Density Measurement based on Millimeter-wave Backhaul Links
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the frequent occurrence of global extreme weather and the deepening of the public demand for weather forecasting, the development of near-surface, wide coverage, high spatial and temporal resolution atmospheric environmental information monitoring means has become more and more important research direction. In this study, an inversion method for rainfall and water vapor based on millimeter-wave backhaul link attenuation parameters is presented based on the rapidly developing cellular network system around the world, and the model performance is verified based on a pair of full-duplex E-band backhaul links (73.5 GHz and 83.5 GHz) measured for about 4 months. The results show that the atmospheric environmental information monitoring method based on E-band backhaul link can obtain accurate rain rate and accumulation in real time, and can be used for long-term effective monitoring of water vapor density near the surface. In the future, with the continuous increase of the frequency of microwave link transmitted by cellular network, it will greatly promote its application in the detection of pollutants, dew, fog and other atmospheric environment information.

articleTitle: Predicting Method for Security Situation of Edge Devices in Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A prediction method based on the improved particle swarm optimization extreme learning machine (IPSO-ELM) algorithm is proposed to address the issues of low prediction accuracy and slow convergence of network security situation prediction models. The particle swarm algorithm is used to optimize the initial input weights and thresholds of the extreme learning machine. The mean square error between the predicted and measured values is used as the fitness function, and the input weights and hidden layer deviations are searched for the best, By continuously updating and iterating, the optimal input weights and thresholds are ultimately obtained. Compared with the extreme learning machine algorithm, the prediction accuracy of the extreme learning machine algorithm combined with particle swarm optimization has been improved. The experimental results show that compared with PSO-ELM, the prediction results of the proposed method in this paper have a fitting degree of 0 99, convergence speed increased by 47.43%. The proposed algorithm is significantly superior to the comparison algorithm in terms of prediction accuracy and convergence speed.

articleTitle: Impact of Spectrum Sensing Data Falsification Attack and Imperfect Reporting Channel on Cooperative Spectrum Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In cognitive radio networks (CRN), spectrum sensing data falsification (SSDF) attack and imperfect reporting channel (RC) are two important factors that affect sensing performance. In practical scenarios, attacks may involve both independent and collaborative forms, as well as imperfect reporting channels that affect cooperative spectrum sensing in a changing form. In this paper, we propose the concept of "mixed attack" and imperfect RC model subject to Rician distribution to analyze its impact on the overall performance of the network system. In the end, we conduct simulations to validate these analyses.

articleTitle: An Efficient Certificate-Based Aggregate Signature Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 9th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aggregate signature is very useful in special areas where the signatures on many different messages generated by many different users need to be compressed and required to be verified only once. Certificate-based cryptography reduces the complicated certificate management in traditional public key cryptography, overcomes key escrow problem in identity-based cryptography and eliminates lower credibility of trusted third party (TTP) in certificateless cryptography. Considering the merits of certificate-based cryptography and aggregate signature, this paper proposes an efficient certificate-based aggregate signature (CBAS) scheme. Its security proof was given in the random oracle mode and it could be reduced to Computational Diffie-Hellman problem. The length of aggregated signature is constant and the signature verification only needs four pairings computation, and it is independent of the number of signers; moreover, our scheme does not need a secure channel. Hence, the new scheme has the advantages of low communication cost and less computation, and it is more suitable for the application scenarios with limited communication resources.
